+package main
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+)
+
+// Constants from tds.go
+const (
+	encryptOff    = 0 // Encryption is available but off.
+	encryptOn     = 1 // Encryption is available and on.
+	encryptNotSup = 2 // Encryption is not available.
+	encryptReq    = 3 // Encryption is required.
+)
+
+// Constants from msdsn/conn_str.go
+const (
+	EncryptionOff      = 0
+	EncryptionRequired = 1
+	EncryptionDisabled = 3
+)
+
+func main() {
+	fmt.Println("Before fix:")
+	fmt.Printf("EncryptionDisabled -> encryptNotSup (%d)\n", encryptNotSup)
+	
+	fmt.Println("\nAfter fix:")
+	fmt.Printf("EncryptionDisabled -> encryptOff (%d)\n", encryptOff)
+	fmt.Printf("EncryptionOff -> encryptOff (%d)\n", encryptOff)
+	fmt.Printf("EncryptionRequired -> encryptOn (%d)\n", encryptOn)
+	
+	fmt.Println("\nThis fix ensures that when 'encrypt=disable' is specified:")
+	fmt.Println("- Client indicates encryption is available but off")
+	fmt.Println("- Server can still require encryption if needed")
+	fmt.Println("- Negotiation works correctly per TDS protocol")
+}
